meta.title: Total proposal value is 0 before selection and equals the awarded amount after
gaps: Deselect the selected line item in the awarding screen and verify Tot. Proposal Value returns to ₹0.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Deselect the selected line item in the awarding screen and verify Tot. Proposal Value returns to ₹0.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS screen.
Enter the awarding screen before any line item is selected.
Verify Tot. Proposal Value is ₹0 before selection.
Select the first vendor for all 10 units of the line item.
Verify Tot. Proposal Value equals the selected vendor's 10 × ₹100 awarded amount.
